entities.title: Laumufarþegi shared code
entities.summary: The rules, the WebSocket protocol and the topic list, imported by both the Worker and the browser page.
entities.purpose: game.ts holds the rules as pure functions over a room's State (the Phase machine, the scoring and the per-player view); protocol.ts the messages between the page and the room and the game's path; topics.ts the topic grids bundled from games/word-lists. Keeping them here lets the Room Durable Object decide everything while the page uses the same types and limits.
boundaries: Nothing here touches the network, the clock or a random source: the Room passes in the time and random numbers, so the tests can replay any game.
The topic data belongs to games/word-lists/ and is only read here, at build time.
The page imports only types, limits and BASE from here; the rules run on the server alone.
